title: US 52 over Mud Creek
source_note: 2020-03-27 Stage 3 · DRAFT / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · Exterior detail modeling candidate
assumptions: The public document is a design draft, not final as-built plans. This model reconstructs that drawing version. A separate 12-page scanned plan set for the existing bridge is available and is not mixed with the new design.
Internal reinforcing bars, tendons and embedded hardware are excluded. Fabrication details absent from the drawings are not claimed as reconstructed.
Colors distinguish components. Individual volumes may overlap at assembly boundaries and must not be summed as a quantity takeoff.
The default view hides the LMC overlay to expose 24 panels and their joints. Enable the overlay layer to view the finished surface.
Elevation 910.80 ft is assigned local vertical coordinate 0. The 135 ft vertical curve and +/-0.5% tangents are modeled parabolically.
Deck, railings and bedding layers are separate model components. Their descriptions identify actual monolithic or precast integration where known.

detail_coverage.detail: Spans 27 + 36 + 27 ft; deck 91 ft 6 in by 40 ft 4 in; 2% crossfall and 135 ft vertical curve.

Separately modeled 24 modules, 8 in longitudinal joints, 12 in transverse pier joints and 13 in abutment joints. Module length follows p39: 26 ft 2 in, distinguished from the p38 overview's 27 ft 3 in notation. Joint profiles and embedded pockets are simplified.

Includes 8 modules per pier with vertical UHPC, rounded wall ends, segmented end bents with the 9 in pavement ledge and 4 wingwalls on 1 in UHPC beds. End-bent seats follow the roadway profile and the precast depths of sheet 24 (bottom El. 926.48; the sheet 23 elevations are 0.27 ft lower and not followed). Pier and end-bent tops, closures included, follow the 2% crossfall, and the beds sit on them. Internal pile pockets are shown as filled envelopes.

Each approach includes 6 panels and connections, with the 4 ft 1 in x 1 ft 6 in outer corner cutbacks. FC railing sections follow sheet 51 (top corner radii omitted); the TFC transitions are 15 ft 8 in long and follow the sections of standard E 706-TTFC-01/-02 (taper drawn on sheets 54, 55; 3/4 in chamfers omitted), with the approach overlay edge on their toe. The 1/2 in neoprene railing joints and the barrier delineators on the upper front face are modelled (sheet 51). The 6 ft sleeper slabs sit as in sheet 59 section B-B; their 2 ft lug step is simplified.
Internal reinforcement, pile lengths, embedded lifting devices, lane markings, continuous roadway and fine surface texture are excluded.

decisions.reading: roadway profile (sheets 9, 21, 62-64) less the 22 1/2 in build-up for the seat, and the written precast depths of sheet 24 for the bottom
decisions.rejected: the absolute elevations of sheet 23 (seat 929.21 / 929.61, bottom 926.21)
decisions.reasoning: The profile appears on four sheets, and the pier sheet 28 (crown 929.95 + written 1 in bed + 1 ft 8 in slab + 1 1/2 in overlay = 931.825 against 931.82) agrees with it. Sheet 24 writes the module depths (3 ft 0 in / 3 ft 4 3/4 in), and the sheet 23 elevation differences repeat them. All five sheet 23 elevations sit a uniform 0.27 ft below that datum, which would need a 4 1/4 in bed against the 1 in drawn on sheets 23, 24, 28 and 53. Keeping El. 926.21 made the modules 3.3 in deeper than written.

decisions.reading: same datum: 3 ft 8 in wing flush with the cap bottom and the ledge top (sheets 24, 27)
decisions.rejected: sheet 23 El. 929.88 at the bent ends
decisions.reasoning: Follows from the end-bent decision; sheet 24 section A-A draws the wing bottom on the cap bottom and its top on the ledge top, under the 1 in bed of sheet 53 section A-A.

decisions.reading: 15 ft 8 in (sheets 53 and 55, standard E 706-TTFC-01 pay limits)
decisions.rejected: 13.17 ft from the sheet 9 station callouts
decisions.reasoning: The structural detail sheets draw 15 ft 8 in, and the standard that sheets 51 (note 4) and 52 make governing for the TFC details writes 15 ft 8 in as its pay limits. The sheet 9 callouts are a 1 in = 50 ft roadway plan and agree with neither.

decisions.reading: sections A-A to D-D of standard E 706-TTFC-01/-02, drawn in plan on sheets 54 and 55
decisions.rejected: the constant FC outline of sheet 53 section A-A
decisions.reasoning: Sheet 51 note 4 and sheet 52 make the standard governing for the TFC details, and it writes every section dimension. The Type IA/IB module plans (sheets 54, 55, 3/4 in = 1 ft) draw the same toe line: 16 in at the joint, 11.64 in at 7 ft 2 in, 9 in at 11 ft 5 in. Sheet 53 section A-A is a typical 3/8 in = 1 ft section cut about 13 ft from the joint, where both of these give a 9 in vertical wall.
